create_struct_series_fields: create a polars struct series and get the list of field names using the fields property
retrieve_struct_field: retrieve a single field from a polars struct series by name using the field method
rename_struct_fields: rename the fields of a polars struct series by providing a sequence of new field names
unnest_struct_series: convert a polars struct series into a dataframe with separate columns for each struct field
encode_struct_to_json: encode a polars struct series into a string column containing JSON values
